title: C: Memory Pool Allocator
description: Implement a simple memory pool allocator that pre-allocates a block of memory and hands out chunks without calling malloc for each allocation.

steps.title: Pool Initialization and Allocation
steps.description: Define a `MemPool` struct with a char* buffer, size, and used count. Write `void pool_init(MemPool *p, int size)` that allocates a buffer. Write `void* pool_alloc(MemPool *p, int size)` that returns a chunk from the pool. Test by allocating 3 ints.
hints: Overflow check: return NULL if not enough space.

verification.failureMessage: Allocate 3 ints from the pool and print them
